hero.sub: Portrait sessions that capture who you are — not how you pose.

manifiesto.label: Manifesto
manifiesto.p1: Most of the people I photograph have never posed before. That's why my work starts long before I pick up the camera — in the conversation, in finding a way for you to let go and simply be yourself.
manifiesto.p2: I work with natural and artificial light to build clean images with intention and character. But technique is the easy part. What matters is what the photo ends up saying about you.

estudio.label: The studio
estudio.p1: I'm Guillermo Álvarez, a portrait photographer based in Mexico City. My technical background taught me to look with precision — today I use that same eye to find the exact gesture that makes a photograph feel real.
estudio.p2: Every session is a collaboration, not a production. I work with natural and artificial light to build images with intention, but the goal is never just to look good — it's to recognize yourself in every image.

servicios.sub: From your first professional portrait to the session that marks a turning point — every project gets the same attention to detail, no matter the size.
servicios.plan1Desc: Individual or as a couple. Studio or natural light. For social media, a professional profile, or just for yourself.
servicios.plan2Desc: Content for your brand, your business, or that digital presence you want to build for real.
servicios.plan2Item3: Full content set for your social media
servicios.plan3Desc: LinkedIn, resume, executive presence. The first impression your professional image makes.
servicios.plan4Desc: Anniversaries, engagements, or simply a keepsake of the two of you — no forced poses.
servicios.plan5Desc: Christmas, birthdays and special dates. A themed portrait session — not party coverage.
servicios.plan5Item3: Limited dates and spots each season
servicios.donde1Desc: The ideal setting for portrait, corporate and directed sessions: the light stays the same from start to finish.
servicios.donde2Name: I bring the studio to you.
servicios.donde2Desc: Lighting and backdrop at your home, office or business. Perfect for work teams or if you'd rather feel on familiar ground.
servicios.donde2Note: All you need is some free space and a power outlet. Travel is quoted based on the area.
servicios.donde3Desc: Parks, streets and corners of the city in daylight. If the weather doesn't cooperate, we reschedule at no cost.
servicios.cotizaNote: Every session is quoted based on what you need. I reply within 24 hours, no commitment.
servicios.notePre: Your project doesn't fit any category?
servicios.notePost: and we'll figure it out together.

proceso.label: The process
proceso.sub: You don't need experience in front of a camera. You need direction. I take care of the rest.
proceso.step1Desc: Via WhatsApp or the form. No commitment, no technical jargon — just tell me what you have in mind.
proceso.step2Desc: A short questionnaire tells me what inspires you, what makes you uncomfortable, and what you want to achieve. I arrive at the session already knowing how to direct you.
proceso.step3Desc: I give you clear direction, pose by pose. You don't need to know what to do with your hands — that's what I'm here for.
proceso.step4Desc: In 3 to 7 days depending on the session type, via Pixieset. Edited photos, ready to show off.
proceso.pay1: Deposit when you book your date

colabora.label: Collaborations
colabora.sub: Every now and then I open space for projects at no cost — not as free promotion, but as a selection of collaborations I'm interested in building. Models, makeup artists, stylists, designers, brands, and content creators: if you have an idea, I want to hear it.
colabora.buscoItem1: A clear idea, even a small one
colabora.buscoItem2: Real commitment to the agreed date
colabora.buscoItem3: A desire to create something outside the commercial mold
colabora.obtienesItem1: A complete session at no cost
colabora.obtienesItem3: Credit and tagging in the published work
colabora.mini2: I review and reply within 5–7 days
colabora.mini3: If there's a match, we coordinate everything
colabora.disclaimer: Not every application is accepted — I select a few projects per season so I can give them the attention they deserve.

testimonios.label: Testimonials
testimonios.q1: "Having this photo session done was one of the best decisions I've made. I was amazed by Memo's creativity in taking advantage of every detail and turning it into a work of art. I look incredible in the photos, but what I'm most grateful for is the atmosphere he created: he was very patient, kind and professional. He has a gift for capturing people's essence. I'd do it again without hesitation!"
testimonios.q2: "I loved how willing you are, your patience and your creativity — you really take it seriously that everything turns out well. It surprised me that you studied the place where the photos would be taken. It was fun and very pleasant, and my husband and I were delighted with the work."
testimonios.q3: "Great vibes! It was an incredible experience from start to finish. What I highlight the most is the patience and the guidance with the poses; I didn't really know how to position myself, but he helped me gain a lot of confidence by giving me options that flow super naturally. I loved that he doesn't just guide you with his professional eye — he's also open to letting you suggest your own ideas, which makes everything feel very authentic and stylish. If you're looking for someone who makes you feel comfortable and confident, and who captures the best of you with a ten-out-of-ten service, this is the place! Highly recommended!"
testimonios.q4: "We had a couples session and he helped a lot to make everything flow, because at first we didn't know how to pose or what to do. The work was delivered on time and in very good quality. I definitely recommend him; he was always very kind, patient and above all professional."
testimonios.q5: "It was my first time at a photo session. Guillermo is very professional and gives you several ideas and references, and above all the confidence to let go and be as normal and natural as possible so you look good in the photos. Highly recommended, I'd definitely go again."
testimonios.q6: "At every moment they made me feel safe. I'm very short and they adjusted the camera stand so everything would turn out well. They showed me the photo and gave me the option to take it again... thank you."
testimonios.q7: "It was a dynamic session, the treatment was courteous, and the photos were taken with attention to detail so we could look our best. They took the trouble to give their recommendations so the photo would turn out well."
testimonios.q8: "He took the time to tell me the best posture for the photo, and to check with me whether I was happy with the image."
testimonios.q9: "The confidence you gave us to propose ideas and feel comfortable with the poses."
